lines.t: Another day beneath the noise
Another pull of passing things
Chasing what will leave me empty
Promises that take their toll
But in the quiet of the evening
When I open up Your Word
But in the quiet of the evening
When I open up Your Word
A spark of truth begins to kindle
Like a fire stirring in my soul
Oh little flame rising up within me
Passion burning in my soul
The Word of God begins to kindle
A fire that cannot be controlled
Oh little flame rising up within me
Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy
Calling me to burn bright
All day long the flesh keeps pulling
Chasing what the world displays
Passing things that promise pleasure
Fading with the passing days
But when I open up Your Word
And truth begins to rise
All the luster of this world
Slowly fades before my eyes
Oh little flame rising up within me
Passion burning in my soul
The Word of God begins to kindle
A fire that cannot be controlled
Oh little flame rising up within me
Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy
Calling me to burn bright
That little flame begins to rise
Fed by every word of truth
Every page becomes a lantern
Lighting paths of deeper proof
All the noise begins to quiet
All the shadows start to part
And the fire born from Scripture
Burns alive within my heart
Let this fire rise within me
Let it shine for all to see
Set apart among the many
Burning bright in purity
Standing firm while others wander
Holding fast to what is true
Zeal for God alive within me
Setting the whole field ablaze
Oh little flame rising up within me
Passion burning in my soul
The Word of God begins to kindle
A fire that cannot be controlled
Oh little flame rising up within me
Standing firm against the night
Truth awakens something holy
Calling me to burn bright
Oh little flame rising up within me
